audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls this HARD at 8.5/10 while the win rate is 51.4% Malphite over 644 games and the already-audited mirror page (audits/top/rumble__malphite.json) settles on 'Even matchup — 52.4% win rate'.
audit.why: Both directions cannot claim a hard lane. Rumble owns Levels 1-3 outright, Malphite owns Level 6 and the first item, and 2+ items is contested — that is an even lane with a shifted timeline, not a hard counter.
audit.corrected: EVEN, 5.5/10: his early, your Level 6, contested after two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes carry no cooldowns and the Level 6 spike claims R knocks him 'out of his Equalizer zone' as if that were the mechanic.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is a 1000-range dash on 130/115/100s. Scrap Shield is 6s. The Equalizer is 130/105/80s at 1750 range. Flamespitter is 10/9/8/7/6s. Those numbers make the timing advice concrete.
audit.corrected: Malphite's spike is Level 6 (1000-range dash, 130s) and the first MR item; Rumble's are Danger Zone Flamespitter windows and The Equalizer at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions absent. (a) Flamespitter is a 3-second continuous cone and Granite Shield only recharges 'if Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds' — while the flame is on you the 10% buffer is permanently at zero. (b) Scrap Shield absorbs damage but does nothing about the knockup on Unstoppable Force, so his shield is not an answer to your engage. (c) Electro Harpoon reduces Magic Resist, so the MR the page tells you to rush is actively shredded by the ability you are buying it against.
audit.why: Riot text, Granite Shield: 'absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.' Flamespitter: 'deals magic damage in a cone for 3 seconds.' Scrap Shield: 'pulls up a shield, protecting him from damage.' Unstoppable Force: 'knocking them into the air.' Electro Harpoon: 'slowing their Move Speed, and reducing their Magic Resist.'
audit.corrected: Written into early, mid, spikes and the cooldown block, matching what the mirror page already states from Rumble's side.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Armor is dead stat here' and 'armor would have been the wrong buy'.
audit.why: Ground Slam 'deals magic damage based on his Armor'. Armour is Malphite's damage stat, not only his defence, so telling a player to write it off against Rumble also deletes his damage. MR still comes first for survival — the two are not the same claim.
audit.corrected: MR first for survival; do not zero out armour, because Ground Slam's damage scales off it.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.late tells you to 'R onto him mid-Equalizer to cancel the cast', and the page writes 'his Equalizer' / 'Drop Equalizer' rather than the ability's real name, The Equalizer.
audit.why: Nothing in the kit file marks The Equalizer as a channel — it carries no channel flag and Riot's text is 'fires off a group of rockets'. I cannot verify that a knockup cancels it, so the advice is removed rather than restated.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the verifiable version: knock him and his carry up together before the carpet lands, from outside Flamespitter's 600-range cone. Ability renamed to The Equalizer throughout.

edits.before: Rumble owns the opening. His Flamespitter (Q) is sustained magic DPS that ignores your Granite Shield faster than you'd like, and his Electro Harpoon (E) slows you so you can never close the gap to use your own Seismic Shard (Q) steal effectively. You have no level 1-2 trade pattern here — your W (Thunderclap) armor and E (Ground Slam) attack-speed slow do nothing against a ranged AP flame kit. Last-hit at max range, eat the poke, and do NOT walk up to throw a Q he'll just harpoon-slow you off of.
edits.after: Rumble owns the opening. Flamespitter (Q) burns for 3 seconds straight, and Granite Shield only recharges once you have gone a few seconds untouched — so while he holds the cone on you, your 10% buffer sits at zero permanently. Electro Harpoon (E) reaches 850 with two charges, slows you and shreds your magic resist on top. Last-hit at the 625 tip of Seismic Shard, break the cone by stepping out rather than trading through it, and never walk up for a Q he will harpoon you off.

edits.before: This is where you claw it back to even. Your W/E come online so you can farm through his Flamespitter, but the real flip is Level 6: Unstoppable Force (R) gives you all-in and roam pressure he can't answer — flash-R or R through the wave to knock him out of his Equalizer (R) zone, then E-W-auto. Critically, build MR not armor — his entire kit is magic, so Mercury's Treads and a Spectre's Cowl do far more than a Bramble Vest ever will. Bait his W shield/move-speed and his E before you commit your R.
edits.after: This is where you claw it back to even. Thunderclap and Ground Slam come online, but the real flip is Level 6: Unstoppable Force is a 1000-range dash on 130 seconds, and Scrap Shield (6s) absorbs the damage while doing nothing about the knockup — his shield is not an answer to your engage. Build magic resist first, but do not zero out armour: Ground Slam's damage scales off it, so armour is offence here too. Watch his Heat — an Overheated Rumble cannot cast, and that is a free window.

edits.before: Late game settles back toward even and can tilt his way in a straight zone war. His Equalizer (R) is one of the best teamfight tools in the game — a long flame carpet that zones your whole team off an objective, and your single-target R engage doesn't out-trade that. Your value is the flank: R onto his backline or onto him mid-Equalizer to cancel the cast. Don't try to 1v1 a fed Rumble in his own flame zone; play the frontline-engage role and let your R open the fight for your carries.
edits.after: Late game settles back toward even and can tilt his way in a straight zone war. The Equalizer (R) is a 1750-range flame carpet on a 130-second cooldown that zones your whole team off an objective, and single-target engage does not out-trade that. Your value is the flank: catch him and a carry in one knockup before the carpet lands, from outside his 600-range cone. Don't 1v1 a fed Rumble inside his own flame; be the frontline and open the fight for your carries.

edits.before: Unstoppable Force (R) is your one clean window — flash-R or R over the wave to knock him out of his Equalizer (R) zone before his flame DPS ramps.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force (R) is your clean window — a 1000-range dash on 130s, and Scrap Shield (6s) absorbs damage but never the knockup that follows.

edits.before: Armor stacking does little here — his Flamespitter and Equalizer are magic damage, so buy MR (Mercs/Spectre's) not armor to make this lane even.
edits.after: Buy MR first — his whole kit is magic, and Electro Harpoon shreds it. But keep armour: Ground Slam's damage scales off it, so it is not a dead stat.

edits.before: His Equalizer (R) zone control out-scales your single-target engage in teamfights; your R flank onto a carry is your only swing back.
edits.after: The Equalizer (R) covers 1750 range on 130s and out-zones your single-target engage; the R flank onto a carry is your swing back.

edits.before: Rumble's Flamespitter (Q) is ranged magic DPS and his harpoon (E) slow keeps you out of Seismic Shard range — you have no level 1 trade.
edits.after: Flamespitter (Q) is a continuous cone that holds Granite Shield at zero, and Electro Harpoon (E) keeps you outside Seismic Shard's 625.

edits.after: An MR item plus the R threat makes this genuinely even — and armour still buys Ground Slam damage, so it is not wasted.

edits.after: Rush MR since his whole kit is magic — but do not drop armour, because Ground Slam's damage scales directly off it

edits.after: Land both Electro Harpoons (E, 850 range) to slow you and shred the magic resist you bought

notes: Mirror reused: audits/top/rumble__malphite.json already established Granite Shield being held at zero by the continuous Flamespitter cone, Ground Slam scaling off armour, Seismic Shard stealing move speed, and Unstoppable Force being a 1000-range dash that Scrap Shield cannot stop. I restated those from Malphite's side rather than re-deriving them, and I matched the mirror's EVEN verdict (it says 'Even matchup — 52.4%'; my packet says 51.4% Malphite over 644 games, so both sides now read even). Could NOT fix inside the length band: content win[5] and win[6] read 'Rumble' and full phases[5].side and phases[6].side read 'Rumble', but the mirror page and the packet levelChart both give First item to Malphite; 'Rumble' (6 chars) to 'Malphite' (8) is +33% and would be rejected. Those four need a manual flip. Also unverifiable and therefore removed rather than restated: 'R onto him mid-Equalizer to cancel the cast' — The Equalizer carries no channel flag and Riot's text does not describe a channel.
